newsitem.title: CHINA: Kee Shing says to buy HK$112 mln property.
newsitem.headline: Kee Shing says to buy HK$112 mln property.

text.p: Kee Shing (Holdings) Ltd said on Tuesday it would buy a Shanghai office property from third party Shanghai Novel Building Co Ltd for HK$112.01 million.

The property, a portion of a 12-storey office building at a major business centre in Shanghai, covers a total gross floor area of 5,559 square metres. The property was valued by an independent valuer at HK$112.38 million as at June 27, it said.

"The acquisition will diversify the properties investment portfolio of the group and improved the rental contribution to the group," Kee Shing said, adding it would hold the property for rental and investment purpose.
Kee Shing is engaged in the trading of electroplating metals and chemicals, paint and coating chemicals, machinery and investments in property.
